description: Start here: what the learner should do now. Reviews due (with dates), concepts to relearn, lessons in progress, the next lesson, and next_step {action: review|finish|continue|start|author|wait, tool, arguments, text} naming the call to make with its arguments (language included where the tool takes one); on start and continue it may carry offer_first, open_link (the lesson in the Studium pane or in the browser) and open_panel (open_lesson_panel's arguments, when this client draws Studium's panel): its text offers them in that order, the learner's last surface first when this client gives it, the chat first (one link given) when they last answered there. finish: Studium refused and kept a draft of this learner's, and no lesson was written since (it comes after a lesson in progress); unfinished_build gives its sources, prepare_sources (the arguments that prepare them again, or null for a source given as text), resend, draft_id and fix_scenes when only those scenes must be sent again, and a keyless outline. If the learner wants it, read the guide, prepare the sources again and call create_lesson (draft_id and only the scenes in fix_scenes when there is a draft_id, else the whole draft); if not, create_lesson {source_set_id, discard: true}. With the minutes a day the learner gave, minutes_per_day and next_step.estimated_minutes size the step. display_markdown is the plan in `language`, ready to show. A learner with no lesson of their own gets the demo lesson shipped with Studium as the step to start (before authoring). Dates (due_date, next_review_date) are days in get_server_info.time_zone.

language.description: fr or en: the language of display_markdown and of the next step; defaults to the language of the learner's last lesson, else the server's

learner_id.description: omit it: this server plays one learner (persistence.learner_id_default), and an id passed here is ignored

now_ms.description: epoch ms, for deterministic scheduling: the session started with it stamps its answers, ratings and reviews there; defaults to the server clock

name: get_study_plan
